scope: Macro focus stacking; long real stacks
status: Engineering taxonomy synthesized from primary evidence; no detectors or thresholds validated

annotation_scale.1: Visible under magnification; negligible structural loss
annotation_scale.2: Clear local defect; measurable structure/radiometry error
annotation_scale.3: Major defect or critical structure loss

constraints: Ordinal labels require rater calibration; not interval-scale numbers
Do not conflate unknown with zero
Do not charge capture-unobserved detail loss as if clean source existed
Assess 100% and intended viewing size under fixed rendering

artifacts.name: Boundary halo and defocus veil
artifacts.appearance: Broad bright, dark or colored band near depth edge; adjacent texture loses contrast.
artifacts.causes: Finite-aperture defocus mixing, wrong source selection or excessive mask smoothing.
artifacts.observability: Output-only alarm is possible; reliable attribution needs stack, depth/visibility boundary and suitable reference.
required_references: Boundary geometry or manual edge labels
Clean source region or declared synthetic target
artifacts.availability: Often contaminated/inferable; never presume clean source exists.
artifacts.severity: Width in pixels and physical units when known; signed amplitude; affected boundary length; lost-detail area.
candidate_measurements: Halo width and integrated excess error by side

artifacts.name: False transparency and background leakage
artifacts.appearance: Sharp background texture visible inside intended opaque foreground.
artifacts.causes: Fusion retains finite-aperture background rays that pass around foreground.
artifacts.observability: Cannot classify reliably from output alone without opacity/visibility evidence.
required_references: Opaque foreground mask at target view
Known background code or reliable source appearance
artifacts.availability: Clean foreground may be directly observed; target visibility must be defined.
artifacts.severity: Leaked area fraction and background-correlated energy inside opaque mask.

artifacts.name: Excess softness and texture loss
artifacts.appearance: Wide edges or reduced fine texture compared with valid focused observations.
artifacts.causes: Blurred selection, blending, interpolation, denoising or excessive smoothing.
artifacts.observability: Needs a valid sharp observation, calibrated target or exact model target.
required_references: Focused source correspondence or target render
artifacts.availability: Charge algorithm only for directly observed or otherwise independently constrained detail.
artifacts.severity: Edge width increase; frequency-specific contrast loss; affected area.

artifacts.name: Thin-structure omission or thickening
artifacts.appearance: Missing, broken, joined or widened hairs, bristles and filaments.
artifacts.causes: Selection regularization and support windows merge small structures; resampling loses width.
artifacts.observability: Requires known line geometry or high-confidence focused sources.
artifacts.availability: Directly observed thin detail is distinguishable from unresolved subpixel structure.
artifacts.severity: Missing length fraction, false length, break count and line-width bias.

artifacts.name: Wrong focus or wrong content selection
artifacts.appearance: Locally blurred patch, depth-inconsistent detail or sharp incorrect region.
artifacts.causes: Focus estimate fails near mixed depth, low texture, noise or repeated patterns.
artifacts.observability: Focus-score maximum alone cannot certify correct content.
artifacts.availability: May be directly observed or indeterminate; identify before scoring.
artifacts.severity: Area and contrast of incorrect selections; focal-plane error only where meaningful.

artifacts.name: Ringing and edge overshoot
artifacts.appearance: Alternating bright/dark bands beside strong edge; artificial extra extrema.
artifacts.causes: Multiscale coefficient inconsistencies, interpolation or sharpening.
artifacts.observability: Output can flag oscillations; source/reference needed to distinguish added error.
artifacts.availability: Usually directly assessable on controlled targets.
artifacts.severity: Overshoot/undershoot amplitude, oscillation energy and decay distance.
artifacts.measurement_status: proposed; prior published ringing metrics require separate validation

artifacts.name: Seams, blotches and smooth-region inconsistency
artifacts.appearance: Visible patch boundaries, swirls, steps or low-frequency mottling.
artifacts.causes: Uncertain source ownership, exposure mismatch, discontinuous masks or depth estimates.
artifacts.observability: Uniform/ramp target gives strong evidence; arbitrary natural scenes ambiguous.
required_references: Flat/ramp reference or reliable low-texture source region
artifacts.availability: Textureless depth may be indeterminate although output smoothness is testable.
artifacts.severity: Added step magnitude, patch area and spatial scale.

artifacts.name: Noise accumulation, grit and false detail
artifacts.appearance: Added grain, speckle or high-frequency structure without scene support.
artifacts.causes: Focus maxima select noise; sharpening or reconstruction amplifies it.
artifacts.observability: Repeated captures or calibrated noise generation needed for reliable separation.
required_references: Repeat exposure or known clean target
artifacts.availability: Noise can be constrained statistically even without exact clean image.
artifacts.severity: Noise variance/power and correlation, stratified by signal and texture.
candidate_measurements: False structure rate on flat fields

artifacts.name: Residual misregistration and double edges
artifacts.appearance: Doubled lines, jagged edges, shifts or local ghost contours.
artifacts.causes: Incorrect global/local transforms, blur-induced matching failure, resampling.
artifacts.observability: Requires correspondences in mutually valid visible regions.
artifacts.availability: Directly observed correspondences only; skip unsupported matches.
artifacts.severity: Landmark/edge displacement and duplicated-edge length.

artifacts.name: Perspective distortion and inconsistent geometry
artifacts.appearance: Locally stretched shapes or crisp mosaic incompatible with one viewpoint.
artifacts.causes: Camera/lens viewpoint changes; a global scale does not model depth-dependent parallax.
artifacts.observability: A visually sharp output is insufficient; geometry and target view needed.
artifacts.availability: Visibility may change; some target rays can be unobserved.
artifacts.severity: Shape/landmark error by depth, local scale bias and visibility inconsistency.

artifacts.name: Temporal ghosts and moving-part duplication
artifacts.appearance: Several antenna/leg positions, semi-transparent ghosts or deformed moving surface.
artifacts.causes: Source frames contain incompatible poses or illumination times.
artifacts.observability: Requires temporal source inspection and explicit target-time policy.
artifacts.availability: No unique static truth when incompatible times are mixed without a target policy.
artifacts.severity: Duplicate count, ghost area and pose discontinuity.

artifacts.name: Color, contrast and tone distortion
artifacts.appearance: Changed hue/saturation, black level, local contrast or overall tone.
artifacts.causes: Multiscale fusion, exposure compensation, color management or tone compression.
artifacts.observability: Need common color pipeline and explicit intended radiometric target.
artifacts.availability: Unsaturated stable diffuse areas most defensible.
artifacts.severity: Color/luminance error distributions; contrast gain and clipped area reported separately.

artifacts.name: Highlight corruption, clipping and bokeh remnants
artifacts.appearance: Extra bright points/disks, altered highlight shape or novel clipped whites.
artifacts.causes: Defocused specular structure selected as detail; contrast expansion; saturated sources.
artifacts.observability: Reliable attribution needs unsaturated data and defined lighting/viewpoint.
required_references: Exposure brackets or unclipped source data
artifacts.availability: Clipped data is indeterminate; view-dependent material cannot use naive fixed-color oracle.
artifacts.severity: Novel clipped area; extra highlight count; shape/energy error.

artifacts.name: Illumination/exposure selection discontinuity
artifacts.appearance: Brightness/chroma patches that follow selected source regions.
artifacts.causes: Flash variation, auto exposure, changing light or local shading.
artifacts.observability: Needs exposure record, stable diffuse regions or known synthetic perturbation.
artifacts.availability: May be correctable when signal unsaturated; local changes can remain ambiguous.
artifacts.severity: Seam contrast and low-frequency radiometric inconsistency.

artifacts.name: Unsupported or fabricated content
artifacts.appearance: Plausible structure that does not match known scene content.
artifacts.causes: Novel coefficient combinations, inferred reconstruction or learned prior.
confounders: True texture unseen in one source
artifacts.observability: Natural-image output alone cannot prove hallucination; known content is required.
artifacts.availability: Judge only where truth is independently known; abstain elsewhere.
artifacts.severity: Incorrect code/feature count, area and amplitude; factual error separate from preference.
artifacts.evidence_status: benchmark risk inferred from reconstruction and fallible reference evidence; not prevalence claim

artifacts.name: Missing focal coverage and focus banding
artifacts.appearance: Soft bands/depth regions despite sharp regions elsewhere.
artifacts.causes: Focus steps too wide; near/far truncation; frame loss; insufficient stack depth.
artifacts.observability: Need full stack and focus-domain target; nominal depth of field alone insufficient.
artifacts.availability: Desired detail may never be directly observed.
artifacts.severity: Uncovered area/depth fraction and worst retained resolution.

artifacts.name: Inherited optical/source defects
artifacts.appearance: Diffraction softness, chromatic fringes, source sharpening, motion blur or clipping.
artifacts.causes: Lens/sensor/exposure/development before stacking.
artifacts.observability: Need source analysis and matched development pipeline.
required_references: Raw sources or calibrated developed inputs
artifacts.availability: Lost detail may be unconstrained; inherited defects must not be misattributed.
artifacts.severity: Source baseline versus output incremental error.

artifacts.name: Dust, hot-pixel and defect trails
artifacts.appearance: Dark or bright linear/wavy trails made from repeated sensor-fixed spots.
artifacts.causes: Alignment moves sensor-fixed defects relative to scene; fusion preserves them.
artifacts.observability: Strong evidence from sensor-coordinate persistence across unaligned sources.
artifacts.availability: Usually detectable without all-in-focus truth.
artifacts.severity: Trail length/area, amplitude and count.

artifacts.name: Invalid borders, edge streaks and coverage loss
artifacts.appearance: Stretched margins, incomplete detail, blank edges or excess crop.
artifacts.causes: Transform support and focal coverage differ across frames.
artifacts.observability: Need per-frame valid support and fixed target canvas.
artifacts.availability: Border desired content may be absent from necessary focus frames.
artifacts.severity: Bad-border area and retained usable field of view.

artifacts.name: Rendering/export/preview artifacts
artifacts.appearance: Banding, profile-dependent color, clipped range, preview moire or compression error.
artifacts.causes: Quantization, color/profile transfer, output format or display rescaling.
artifacts.observability: Compare saved files at native resolution under controlled color pipeline.
artifacts.availability: Distinct from fusion quality; retained file may differ from preview.
artifacts.severity: Quantization/encoding error and true saved-file defect area.
